messages:
emma: Heads up, saw an uptick in streaming fncall rejects from eu-west5. Most flagged as 'partial-json' and appear to be chunk-level artifacts. Anyone else?

infra-bot: alert: invoke-gateway.validation.partial_json spike. 94 events in 10m.

julio: we've been validating each chunk strictly to reject fast. downside: middle-of-stream partial json triggers hard rejects.

priya: quick thought: instead of deferring completely, we could run a fast heuristic per chunk that yields a score (0-1). If score < 0.2 => PASS, 0.2-0.7 => WARN and continue, >0.7 => soft-fail but wait for final. Then final frame runs full schema validator.

emma: that sounds reasonable. how do we avoid wasting downstream tool calls when the model is constantly low-score?

dan: add an adaptive backpressure: if stream_warn_rate for a route > X% for Y mins, mark route as degraded and short-circuit to fallback earlier. X and Y configurable per customer.

nina-ux: console needs visibility. propose three metrics: chunk_heuristic_warn_rate, route_degraded_flags, final_schema_reject_rate. Also show a timeline of sampled WARN payloads for debugging.

billing-bot: note: current billing attributes invocation_mode at completion. If we short-circuit to fallback earlier, attach billing_tag=fallback_early and fallback_reason=stream_hint_low. Will surface in cost explorer and invoices.

julio: telemetry plan: emit fields chunk_score, stream_hint=(pass|warn|softfail), final_validation=(pass|fail), route_degraded=(true|false), sample_id for stored payloads. Sample WARNs at 0.5% by default with opt-up.

priya: rollout: feature flag "stream-validate-adaptive". Canary 5% for 24h, compare control vs variant on these deltas: final_schema_reject_rate, tool_success_rate, cost_per_1000_calls. Rollback if final rejects + tool_success drop > threshold.

emma: tests: unit tests for fragmented SSE and http-chunked, integration tests with slow connections, chaos test where last frame never arrives.

dan: implementation notes: place heuristic in streaming parser path (low latency). Heuristic must avoid allocations and be vectorized where possible. Full schema validator stays in separate non-blocking worker.

nina-ux: small UI asks: filterable table for fallback_reason, toggle to show sampled payloads (default off), and a note explaining why early fallback might increase text charges.

julio: perf concerns: metrics cardinality. chunk_score histogram + stream_hint tag should be low-cardinality. Avoid storing raw payloads except sampled id refs.

priya: action items:
- julio: PR heuristic + feature flag (1743333340)
- infra: add telemetry fields + sampling pipeline (assign: @infra-eng)
- console: panels + sample viewer (nina-ux)
- billing: add fallback tags to billing events (billing-bot)
- qa: create fragment-simulator harness for canary (assign: qa-team)

emma: any objections?

dan: none from me. just ensure the heuristic thresholds are tunable per route.

nina-ux: will draft UI mocks and link.

julio: will post design doc and microbench numbers before PR.

infra-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary for stream-validate-adaptive -> 5% at 2024-05-03T03:30:00Z.

emma: thanks folks. I'll open a ticket to track rollout and link this thread. :thumbsup:
